title: Minecraft Dungeons II
summary: Minecraft Dungeons II is Mojang's dungeon-crawler sequel, released on Switch 2 on September 29, 2026, at $29.99. It is a small install at 6 GB, so storage will not be a problem. The physical version is a Game-Key Card, which means the cartridge only unlocks the download, and you need an internet connection to install it. It is built for co-op: up to 4 players on one console or up to 4 online. With 16 languages, including Spanish, it has one of the widest language lists on Switch 2. Performance figures have not been published yet.
